name: Karel de Grote University of Applied Sciences and Arts
summary: University of applied sciences in Antwerp with four English-taught professional bachelor's: computing, business, multimedia and nursing.

handoff.label: Apply for an English-taught bachelor's degree

ib.text: Any diploma giving access to comparable study at home; no interview or test. English B2: an IB with English A or English B at 5 or higher counts as proof. €139.40 application fee, deducted from tuition.

programmes.name: International Business Management
programmes.ib: Shared first year, then Global Business, Global Supply Chain Management or International Entrepreneurship.

programmes.name: Nursing
programmes.ib: English B2 with speaking at C1 (e.g. IELTS speaking 7.0). Dutch is taught in the programme and used with patients on Flemish placements.

notes: For 2026-27, EEA nationals had no application or payment deadline; the 2027 deadlines are not yet published.
You can apply before you graduate with a school statement of expected graduation, and you get a conditional offer.
